extension.summary: ABUKARIM TOOLS - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, OpenWizard maintenance shortcuts (cache, packages and thumbnail cleanup), and the ABUKARIM Wizard. A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، واختصارات صيانة OpenWizard (تنظيف الذاكرة المؤقتة والحزم والصور المصغّرة)، ومعالج أبوكريم. كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v3.1.0.25 - AF3: Vertical Plot (Home) now also shows the Home plot in the smaller mini font (font_mini_plot); plot font elsewhere unchanged. v3.1.0.24 - New patch toggle "AF3: Vertical Plot (Home)": the Arctic Fuse 3 Home plot scrolls vertically like AF2 instead of horizontally. v3.1.0.23 - Add-on Portal auto-answers every "Add-on required / enable?" prompt during and just after installing (POV re-enables itself from its own service). v3.1.0.22 - No more "Add-on required / enable this add-on?" popups after installing from the Add-on Portal or Skin Selection - add-ons are enabled silently. v3.1.0.21 - Fix: Run First-Time Setup did nothing in 3.1.0.20 (script launched without add-on context); now launched via RunPlugin. v3.1.0.20 - First-run: welcome splash removed; steps no longer overlap (auto-patch sweeps pause during setup, setup runs detached from the menu, swallowed dialogs are re-shown instead of being treated as Skip). v3.1.0.19 - First-run setup now opens the Add-on Portal after the restore step (before patches and Skin Selection); Back skips it. v3.1.0.18 - Skin Selection redesigned: repository picker is now three large neon cards, and the skin gallery shows a live details panel (preview, name, installed state) beside a 3-column screenshot grid. v3.1.0.17 - New Add-on Portal (Setup & Install): tick any of 9 video add-ons (Dex Hub, DPlex, Fen Light+, Last Played, POV, Red Light, Seren, Umbrella, YouTube) and install them from their pinned repositories, with repos, dependencies and update origin handled automatically. v3.1.0.16 - Backup Manager: addon_data/plugin.program.abukarimtools is now excluded from both backup and restore (older backups that contain it are skipped on restore). v3.1.0.15 - Fix Kodi freezing when opening the add-on (TinyPPI fonts.py regex).
